problem_text:
A logistics manager is selecting cargo packages for a shipment. Available packages are:
* Package 1: volume 10 m³, revenue $141
* Package 2: volume 36 m³, revenue $98
* Package 3: volume 35 m³, revenue $68
* Package 4: volume 29 m³, revenue $255
* Package 5: volume 14 m³, revenue $102
* Package 6: volume 39 m³, revenue $193
* Package 7: volume 39 m³, revenue $137
* Package 8: volume 46 m³, revenue $55
* Package 9: volume 35 m³, revenue $264
* Package 10: volume 14 m³, revenue $160
* Package 11: volume 25 m³, revenue $149
* Package 12: volume 33 m³, revenue $113
* Package 13: volume 23 m³, revenue $218
* Package 14: volume 21 m³, revenue $20
* Package 15: volume 3 m³, revenue $108
* Package 16: volume 13 m³, revenue $93
* Package 17: volume 36 m³, revenue $244
* Package 18: volume 6 m³, revenue $138

The cargo container has a maximum capacity of 319 m³. Choose the package combination that yields the highest total revenue without exceeding this volume limit. Each package must be either fully accepted or rejected.
